module: Editor window "Engine Audio Debug" (Audio menu) to tune the player vehicle's engine sound live. It fetches the engine sound data on the vehicle side (sounds.getEngineSoundData via queueLuaCommand), offers a list of engines/sounds and sliders (main gain, on/off-load, low/high shelves, low/high EQ, fundamental frequency per cylinder count, muffling), displays the exhaust direction, and lets you copy the values as JSON to the clipboard or reset everything to 0. Frequencies in Hz are converted to FMOD values (table 20 Hz to 22 kHz).
notes: M.onUpdate is nop by default; it is only replaced by the real function when the window is shown (onEditorToolWindowShow) and reset to nop when it is closed, with extensions.hookUpdate("onUpdate") to rebuild the hook list.
M.onDebugDrawActive is exported but the local variable onDebugDrawActive is never defined in the file: the field is nil.
The engine data is written by the vehicle into editor_engineAudioDebug.engine (engineSoundData, engineNameStrings) via queueGameEngineLua: it arrives with a slight delay.

onUpdate.desc: nop while the window is closed; draw/update function when it is open.

onDebugDrawActive.desc: Exported but always nil (undefined local variable).

open.desc: Displays the "Engine Audio Debug" window and forces a refresh of the values.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: reads the engine sound data of the player vehicle.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Registers the window (500x200) and the menu entry (Audio group).

onEditorActivated.desc: Hook: reloads the engine data on entering the editor.

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Hook: hides the display of the exhaust direction of the selected engine.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called on vehicle switch; reloads the data if the editor is active.

onEditorToolWindowShow.desc: Hook called when a tool window is shown; if it is the module's window, enables onUpdate.

onEditorToolWindowHide.desc: Hook called when a tool window is hidden; if it is the module's window, resets onUpdate to nop.
